OmaStats 1.3 lets each disk show its own bar readout: transfer speed, space used, or both.

![OmaStats bar with a space-used ring for the NVMe disk next to CPU, memory and network](https://github.com/crmne/omastats/releases/download/v1.3.0/omastats-1.3.0-disk-used.png)

- The Disks module now works like the GPU module. Settings → Bar → Disks lists "All disks" and every block device. Each one has its own switch and a Speed / Used / Both choice.
- Speed draws the read/write graph and rates. Used draws a ring and a percentage. When several disks share the bar, each gets a short tag: `DSK`, `NV0`, `SDA`, `MC0`.
- Space used adds up every mounted volume on that disk. "All disks" adds up every local disk and never counts network mounts.
- The disk the Disks panel page follows is now set under Settings → Panel → Disks. It no longer changes the bar.
- Existing setups look the same until you change a disk in Settings. The first change saves the current layout as the new `barDisks` setting.
- With utilization colors on, disk space-used figures and rings use the same four grades as CPU, GPU and memory.

Both bundled binaries are rebuilt twice in CI, compared byte-for-byte with the committed executables, and covered by checksums and GitHub build attestations.

The normal plugin installation remains:

```sh
omarchy plugin add https://github.com/crmne/omastats.git --enable
```
